title_en: Jilin Dongrun Real Estate Development Co., Ltd. v. Jilin Jialei Real Estate Group Co., Ltd. and Third-Party Dashang Co., Ltd. — dispute over a joint venture and cooperative development of real estate contract
ruling_gist_en: Where, after signing a contract and during the process of performance, the parties enter into multiple supplementary agreements to modify the original contract due to changes in circumstances, such supplementary agreements shall be deemed valid as long as they represent the true intent of the parties and their content complies with legal provisions. If the parties dispute the performance content of multiple supplementary agreements, the final performance content shall be determined based on the inherent connection between the agreements, the completeness of the allocation of rights and obligations as agreed therein, and the chronological order of the signing and formation of the supplementary agreements, in accordance with the principles of fairness and good faith under civil law.

full_text_en:
Jilin Dongrun Real Estate Development Co., Ltd. v. Jilin Jialei Real Estate Group Co., Ltd. and Third Party: Dashang Co., Ltd. — Dispute over Joint Venture and Cooperative Development of Real Estate Contract

Ruling Summary

Where, after entering into a contract and during the performance thereof, the parties enter into multiple supplementary agreements amending the original contract due to changes in circumstances, the supplementary agreements shall all be deemed valid as long as they represent the true intent of the parties and their contents comply with legal provisions. In the event of a dispute between the parties over the content of performance under multiple supplementary agreements, the final content of performance under the agreements shall be determined based on the internal connections between the agreements, the completeness of the allocation of rights and obligations stipulated therein, and the chronological order in which the supplementary agreements were signed and became effective, in accordance with the principles of fairness and good faith under civil law.

Supreme People's Court
Civil Judgment

(2010) Min Yi Zhong Zi No. 109

Appellant (Defendant at First Instance): Jilin Jialei Real Estate Group Co., Ltd. (formerly Yanji Jialei Real Estate Development Co., Ltd.), domiciled at No. 2169, Tianchi Road, Henan Street, Yanji City, Jilin Province.

Legal Representative: Liu Xu, Chairman of the Board of the Company.

Agent ad litem: He Yongjun, lawyer with Beijing Zhongwen Law Firm.

Appellee (Plaintiff at First Instance): Jilin Dongrun Real Estate Development Co., Ltd., domiciled at No. 33, Longli Road, Chaoyang District, Changchun City, Jilin Province.

Legal Representative: Wang Lina, Chairman of the Board of the Company.

Agent ad litem: Peng Ya, lawyer with Beijing King & Wood Law Firm.

Agent ad litem: Jiao Zhi, lawyer with Beijing King & Wood Law Firm.

Third Party at First Instance: Dashang Co., Ltd., domiciled at No. 1, Qingsan Street, Zhongshan District, Dalian City, Liaoning Province.

Legal Representative: Niu Gang, Chairman of the Board of the Company.

Agent ad litem: Chi Renhui, staff member of the Company.

Agent ad litem: Li Dawei, male, born on February 14, 1963, residing at Room 611, Unit 5, Building 1, Tanhuang Community, Chaishi Road, Dong'an District, Mudanjiang City, Heilongjiang Province.

In the case of the dispute over a joint venture and cooperative development of real estate contract between the Appellant Jilin Jialei Real Estate Group Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Jialei Company) and the Appellee Jilin Dongrun Real Estate Development Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Dongrun Company), and the Third Party at First Instance Dashang Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Dashang Company), the Jilin High People's Court rendered Civil Judgment (2009) Ji Min Yi Chu Zi No. 1 on August 10, 2010. Jialei Company, dissatisfied with the judgment, appealed to this Court. This Court lawfully formed a collegial panel and conducted an inquiry of the parties in this case on March 21, 2011. He Yongjun, the agent ad litem of Jialei Company, Peng Ya and Jiao Zhi, the agents ad litem of Dongrun Company, and Chi Renhui, the agent ad litem of Dashang Company, participated in the inquiry. This case is now concluded.

The court of first instance found through trial the following facts:

On April 20, 2005, Dongrun Company and Jialei Company signed a "Letter of Intent for Cooperation," reaching an intent to jointly develop and construct a large shopping mall using the existing development land of Jialei Company.

On December 16, 2005, Dongrun Company and Jialei Company signed a "Joint Development Agreement" for the cooperative development, stipulating: Project Name: Dongjia Shopping Center, located in Jinxue District, Yanji City. Its boundaries are: east to Yanji Jinxue Primary School, south to Jiefang Road, west to Huaqiao Flower Market, and north to Renmin Road. The planned land area is approximately 20,000 square meters, with the land area determined by the land approval certificate being 14,690.23 square meters (including the basement level area of the Jinxue Primary School playground); the building has six floors, with two underground floors and five above-ground floors, with partial seventh floor, frame structure, total construction area of approximately 57,000 square meters, subject to the area surveyed by the real estate management department; use as commercial complex, i.e., commerce, warehousing, office, etc.; the sales revenue from the joint development project shall first be used for the construction funds of the joint development project until the project is completed, and then used to compensate for the cost inputs of both parties; the after-tax income from the cooperation (including appraised assets) shall be distributed in the proportion of 65% to Dongrun Company and 35% to Jialei Company. During the joint development, Dongrun Company and Jialei Company went through the project approval formalities in the names of both parties, obtained the "Construction Land Planning Permit," "Construction Engineering Planning Permit," "Construction Land Approval Certificate," organized construction, and carried out corresponding sales work.

In June 2007, when the construction of the Dongjia Shopping Center had reached the stage where the main structure was basically topped out, the parties, after negotiation, signed an "Agreement" on June 28, 2007, i.e., the June 28 Agreement, terminating the performance of the "Joint Development Agreement" and stipulating their respective rights and obligations after termination as follows: 1. Party A (Dongrun Company) and Party B (Jialei Company) agree that from the effective date of this Agreement, the "Joint Development Agreement" signed by both parties on December 16, 2005, shall cease to be effective, and the rights and obligations of both parties shall be performed in accordance with the provisions of this Agreement. 2. Rights and obligations of Party A. (1) Party A voluntarily waives its shares in the cooperative project of both parties. (2) Party A owns the ownership of the following properties: the street-level shops on the south side of Jiefang Road on the first floor of the shopping mall, with a construction area of 655.07 square meters on the first floor and a mezzanine area of 655.07 square meters; the independently constructed nine-story building (floors 1 to 9) on the east side of Jialei Zhuangyuan Mansion, with a construction area of 3,899.07 square meters; and the interior shops in the northwest corner of the shopping mall, with a construction area of 1,000 square meters, enjoying the rights of possession, use, benefit, and disposal. The specific location of the interior shops in the northwest corner of the shopping mall is: north to south of axis I-K (excluding the area occupied by Walmart's unloading area), south to the north of the edge line of the Walmart main passageway between axes I-E and I-F (2.4 meters south of axis I-F), east to the west of the edge line of the Walmart main passageway between axes I-6 and I-7 (3 meters east of axis I-6), west to axis I-2 (excluding stairwells, freight elevator rooms and their anterooms, automatic escalator fire protection areas, and main passageways within the area, etc.). The above construction areas are ultimately subject to the survey data of the real estate surveying department (including public apportionment areas). Party A shall have no other rights or responsibilities. (3) Party A may transfer or operate the above-mentioned properties allocated to it on its own, and all proceeds from such transfer or operation shall belong solely to Party A. (4) Party A is responsible for signing a house lease contract with Walmart before August 1, 2007; however, if the signing is delayed due to unforeseeable factors such as project progress, design, quality, or changes in national policies, the signing period may be extended. (5) Party A shall assist Party B in later tenant recruitment work; the recruitment contract shall be signed separately. (6) If, due to reasons attributable to Party A, Party A fails to fulfill the obligations stipulated in Article 2, Paragraph 4 of this Agreement, then Party A shall not enjoy all the rights stipulated in Article 2 of this Agreement. 3. Rights and obligations of Party B. (1) Party B is responsible for the construction of the follow-up works of the contracted project; both Party A and Party B shall be jointly responsible for the quality of the cooperative project (civil engineering part of the shopping mall), and the houses shall meet the national acceptance standards for completion. (2) Party B shall be responsible for handling, within 180 days after the completion acceptance of the project, the House Ownership Certificate and Land Use Right Certificate for the above-mentioned houses allocated to Party A, with the costs borne in accordance with relevant national regulations. (3) Party B owns the ownership of the cooperatively developed houses (except for the houses allocated to Party A), i.e., enjoys the rights of possession, use, benefit, and disposal. (4) Party B agrees to repay the funds invested by Party A in the amount of RMB 21 million to Party A according to the following repayment plan, and deposit them into the account designated by Party A. Specific repayment times: RMB 1 million before July 1, 2007; RMB 1 million before August 1, 2007; RMB 3 million before September 1, 2007; and the remaining amount shall be paid in a lump sum before December 1, 2007. (5) Within the scope of Party A's properties, for the portion already sold as of the date of signing this Agreement (referring to funds already received, with a total of 9 sales contracts and 2 subscription agreements), Party B promises to return the funds to Party A in three installments and deposit them into the account designated by Party A. Specific repayment times: one-third of the above sale proceeds to Party A before January 30, 2008; another one-third of the above sale proceeds to Party A before February 30, 2008; and the remaining portion of the above sale proceeds to Party A before March 30, 2008. (6) After the date of signing this Agreement, within the scope of Party A's properties, for the portion of sold funds not yet received, including mortgage loans, such funds shall be deposited into the account designated by Party A within three days after receipt. (7) Within the scope of Party A's properties, for the sold units where the buyers have defaulted, they shall be dealt with according to Party A's requirements; if a refund is required, Party B shall raise funds to refund the sale proceeds to the buyers. Party B agrees that Party A may sell Party A's allocated houses in the name of Party B, and Party B shall assist Party A in handling procedures for house sales, bank mortgages, house property rights, etc. All relevant taxes, bank guarantee deposits, handling fees, and other expenses arising therefrom shall be borne by Party A; Party B shall deduct such expenses from the sale proceeds based on relevant legitimate and legal invoices. The funds from Party A's house sales shall be deposited into the account designated by Party A within three days after receipt. 4. Party B promises that the entire shopping mall will open for business before January 1, 2008. If Walmart's signing is delayed, the opening date of the shopping mall shall be postponed accordingly. The payment date stipulated in Article 3, Paragraph 5 of this Agreement shall also be postponed accordingly. 5. With respect to the interior shops in the shopping mall owned by Party A, Party A shall, in terms of management, comply with the relevant unified management regulations of the shopping mall and pay various fees according to law. If Party A transfers the house property rights, it shall notify Party B one month in advance; under the same conditions, Party B has the right of first refusal. 6. After this Agreement takes effect, neither party may amend or rescind this Agreement without authorization. If a party requests to amend or rescind this Agreement, it shall promptly notify the other party in writing, and a supplementary agreement shall be signed after negotiation. 7. Liability for breach of contract. Both Party A and Party B shall perform their respective obligations in accordance with the provisions of this Agreement. Any party that violates the provisions of this Agreement shall bear liability for breach of contract. The breaching party shall pay liquidated damages to the non-breaching party, with the liquidated damages calculated at the upper limit of the relevant national provisions based on the base amount of liquidated damages, and shall compensate the non-breaching party for all economic losses arising therefrom. 8. Dispute resolution method. In the event of a dispute during the performance of this Agreement, the parties shall resolve it through negotiation; if negotiation fails, either party may file a lawsuit with a competent court. 9. If force majeure events such as earthquakes, typhoons, war, or changes in government policies, and other unforeseeable events that cannot be prevented or avoided in terms of their occurrence and consequences, directly affect the performance of this Agreement or make it impossible to perform under the agreed conditions, the affected party shall immediately notify the other party of the situation, and within fifteen days provide proof and an explanation report detailing the event and the reasons why this Agreement cannot be performed, can only be partially performed, or requires an extension of performance. The parties shall not be liable to each other. 10. Matters not covered in this Agreement shall be subject to further negotiation between the parties, and a supplementary agreement shall be signed. If there is any inconsistency between the supplementary agreement and this Agreement, the supplementary agreement shall prevail. 11. This Agreement shall take effect upon being signed by the legal representatives or authorized representatives of both parties. All agreements signed by both parties before the effectiveness of this Agreement shall be automatically repealed.

After the June 28 Agreement was signed, Dongrun Company withdrew from the cooperative project, and Jialei Company took over responsibility for the subsequent construction management of the project. According to the provisions of the June 28 Agreement, Jialei Company was required to repay RMB 1 million to Dongrun Company before July 1, 2007, and another RMB 1 million before August 1, 2007; Dongrun Company was required to sign a lease agreement with Walmart before August 1, 2007. However, except for repaying RMB 1 million to Dongrun Company on June 18, 2007, Jialei Company did not make any other payments, and Dongrun Company failed to sign a house lease contract with Walmart before August 1, 2007.

Due to the aforementioned issues arising during the performance of the June 28 Agreement, Dongrun Company and Jialei Company reached a "Supplementary Agreement" on September 20, 2007, i.e., the September 20 Agreement, with respect to further performance. The main stipulations were: Whereas the "Agreement" signed by Party A (Dongrun Company) and Party B (Jialei Company) on June 28, 2007, represents the true intent of both parties and is lawful and valid. In order to better perform the obligations stipulated in the Agreement, the parties now make the following supplementary stipulations regarding issues arising during the performance of the Agreement: 1. Within three days after the Walmart agreement is signed, Party B shall pay RMB 1 million to Party A; one month later, Party B shall pay RMB 3 million to Party A. The remaining outstanding amount shall be paid off within four months after the Walmart agreement is signed. 2. When Party B obtains loans secured by commercial properties, it shall repay Party A in proportion. The specific proportion is: for loans up to RMB 20 million, no repayment is required; for loans exceeding RMB 20 million, one-fourth of the loan amount shall be repaid. Party B promises to repay the amounts due to Party A within three days from the date the loan is credited. 3. The remaining amounts shall be paid in a lump sum after the project is accepted and Party B obtains loans secured by unencumbered commercial properties. 4. Party A promises to complete the signing of the Walmart agreement before October 20. Party B promises to pay off all amounts owed to Party A within five months from the date of Walmart's signing. If Party B fails to repay all amounts on time, Party B shall provide the property rights of the second floor of the shopping mall as collateral. Party A may use the collateral for loans and financing, and Party B shall be responsible for repayment and interest. 5. Before Party A obtains all its interests, it shall retain its shareholder status. 6. This supplementary agreement shall take effect upon being signed by the legal representatives or authorized representatives of both parties.

On the same day the September 20 Agreement was signed, Wang Yingchao and Liu Xu signed a "Share Transfer Agreement," under which Wang Yingchao transferred his 65% shares in Yanji Dongjia Youmart Shopping Plaza Co., Ltd. to Liu Xu at a transfer price of RMB 650,000.

Pursuant to the September 20 Agreement, on September 30, 2007, Dongrun Company, together with Jialei Company, signed a "House Lease Agreement" with Walmart, leasing to Walmart the unloading area on the first floor and the shopping mall on the first underground floor and second underground floor of the Dongjia Shopping Center, with a total area of 15,855 square meters, for the purpose of opening a shopping plaza. After the lease agreement was signed, Walmart entered the premises for decoration and construction.

On August 26, 2008, Jialei Company unilaterally signed a "House Lease Contract" with Dashang Company, leasing an area of 45,601.76 square meters of the Dongjia Shopping Center, including the area leased to Walmart, to Dashang Company. In response, Walmart sent letters to Jialei Company and Dongrun Company on September 10, September 12, and November 24, 2008, pointing out Jialei Company's breach of contract and demanding continued performance of the "House Lease Agreement."

On December 25, 2008, Walmart, Jialei Company, and Dashang Company jointly signed an "Agreement." After Dashang Company paid Walmart compensation of over RMB 5 million as agreed, Walmart withdrew, and Dashang Company continued the decoration and put the Dongjia Shopping Center into use.

It was further found that among the houses allocated to Dongrun Company under the June 28 Agreement, nine sets had been sold, with a total sale price of RMB 13,144,873, and Jialei Company agreed to pay the sale proceeds to Dongrun Company in installments.

The specific situation of the houses allocated to Dongrun Company and those sold is as follows: 1. Interior shops in the northwest corner of the shopping mall, 1,000 square meters (specific location: north to south of axis I-K, excluding the area occupied by Walmart's unloading area; south to the north of the edge line of the Walmart main passageway between axes I-E and I-F (2.4 meters south of axis I-F); east to the west of the edge line of the Walmart main passageway between axes I-6 and I-7 (3 meters east of axis I-6); west to axis I-2, excluding stairwells, freight elevator rooms and their anterooms, automatic escalator fire protection areas, and main passageways within the area, etc.). Of these, interior shops with an area of 151.5 square meters (location numbers 1N-A26, 1N-A034, 1N-BO62, 1N-B61) had been sold, leaving 848.5 square meters. 2. Street-level shops on the south side of Jiefang Road on the first floor of the shopping mall: first floor construction area 655.07 square meters, mezzanine floor construction area 655.07 square meters. Of these, the first floor shops with an area of 287.23 square meters (location numbers 1M-06, 1M-08, 1M-07, 1M-05, 1M-06) and mezzanine shops had remaining areas of 417.84 square meters on the first floor and 417.84 square meters on the mezzanine.

After the September 20 Agreement was signed, Jialei Company failed to repay Dongrun Company's investment funds and the house sale proceeds due, totaling RMB 31,344,873, before February 28, 2008, as agreed, nor did it deliver the houses due to Dongrun Company under the June 28 Agreement.

Dongrun Company filed an action with the court of first instance, alleging that on December 26, 2005, it entered into a Joint Development Agreement with Jialei Company to jointly develop and construct the Dongjia International Shopping Center Commercial Complex, and obtained project approval procedures in the name of both parties, secured a Construction Land Planning Permit and a Construction Land Approval Certificate, jointly bid for and acquired the project's land use rights, and Dongrun Company introduced the construction team and successively invested multiple sums of construction funds, enabling the project to proceed smoothly. In June 2007, when the Dongjia Shopping Center project had progressed to the topping-out of the main structure, coinciding with the peak season for commercial real estate sales, Jialei Company proposed to proceed with development and construction unilaterally, and offered to return Dongrun Company's investment and provide a portion of the premises as compensation for Dongrun Company's withdrawal. After negotiation, the parties signed the June 28 Agreement on June 28, 2007. Article 3 thereof stipulated that Jialei Company should repay Dongrun Company's investment of RMB 21 million in installments before December 1, 2007. Article 2 stipulated that Dongrun Company should be allocated the following premises under construction: 1. A ground-floor street-facing storefront on the south side of Dongjia Shopping Center with a construction area of 655.07 square meters; 2. A separately constructed nine-story building on the east side of Jialei Scholar Mansion, floors 1 to 9, with a construction area of 3,899.07 square meters; 3. An inner shop at the northwest corner of the first floor of Dongjia Shopping Center with a construction area of 1,000 square meters. Since some of the above premises allocated to Dongrun Company had already been sold to external parties, Articles 3(5) and 3(6) further stipulated that Jialei Company would pay in installments in cash the proceeds from the sold premises to Dongrun Company. According to the nine commercial housing sales contracts provided by Jialei Company, as of the signing of the June 28 Agreement, the proceeds from the sold premises amounted to RMB 13,144,873. For the remaining unsold premises: (1) a south-side street-facing storefront on the ground floor with a construction area of 417.84 square meters and a mezzanine floor with a construction area of 417.84 square meters; (2) the separately constructed nine-story building on the east side of Jialei Scholar Mansion, floors 1 to 9, with a construction area of 3,899.07 square meters; (3) an inner shop at the northwest corner of Dongjia Shopping Center with a construction area of 848.5 square meters. Jialei Company was responsible for handling the issuance of property ownership certificates and land use certificates for Dongrun Company. Pursuant to Article 2(4) of the June 28 Agreement, Dongrun Company's obligation upon withdrawal from the joint development was to sign a lease agreement with Wal-Mart before August 1, 2007. After the June 28 Agreement was signed, in response to Jialei Company's overdue repayment of investment funds and delay in submitting design drawings, which caused a delay in signing with Wal-Mart, Dongrun Company and Jialei Company reached the September 20 Agreement on September 20, 2007, wherein the parties re-stipulated that if Dongrun Company could sign a contract with Wal-Mart before October 20, 2007, then within five months after Dongrun Company signed the contract with Wal-Mart, Jialei Company would return all funds occupied by Dongrun Company and perform all obligations. Through Dongrun Company's active efforts, Dongrun Company, Jialei Company, and Wal-Mart jointly signed a Lease Agreement on September 30, 2007. Thus, Dongrun Company timely performed all obligations under the agreement. However, to date, Jialei Company, apart from returning investment of RMB 1 million, has not performed the obligations under the June 28 Agreement and the September 20 Agreement. It has neither paid off any other amounts (investment and proceeds from sold premises totaling RMB 33,144,873) nor delivered the premises to Dongrun Company. Moreover, Jialei Company unilaterally and privately terminated the lease agreement with Wal-Mart and leased the entire inner shop of 858.5 square meters, which should have been allocated to Dongrun Company, to Dashang Company. Dashang Company commenced operations on December 26, 2008. In addition, without Dongrun Company's permission, Jialei Company began using floors 6 to 9 of the independently constructed nine-story building (which should have been allocated to Dongrun Company) from February 14, 2009. In summary, Dongrun Company repeatedly demanded that Jialei Company perform the agreements and rectify its breaches, but Jialei Company ignored them. Left with no choice, Dongrun Company filed this action in accordance with the law, requesting: (1) confirmation that the June 28 Agreement and the September 20 Agreement are valid; (2) an order that Jialei Company return Dongrun Company's investment of RMB 20 million, and pay liquidated damages until the investment is fully repaid (as of May 31, 2009, the liquidated damages amount to RMB 2,492,014); (3) an order that Jialei Company return the proceeds from the sold portion of the premises within the scope of Dongrun Company's entitlement, totaling RMB 13,144,873, and pay liquidated damages until the proceeds are fully repaid (as of May 31, 2009, the liquidated damages amount to RMB 1,654,034); (4) an order that Jialei Company deliver premises valued at RMB 61,384,620 (the final value to be determined by appraisal), including: a ground-floor street-facing storefront on the south side of Dongjia Shopping Center with a construction area of 417.84 square meters, a mezzanine floor with a construction area of 417.84 square meters, floors 1 to 9 of the independently constructed nine-story building on the east side of Jialei Scholar Mansion with a construction area of 3,899.07 square meters, and an inner shop at the northwest corner of Dongjia Shopping Center with a construction area of 848.5 square meters, and assist Dongrun Company in obtaining the corresponding property ownership certificates and land use certificates, and pay liquidated damages until the premises are actually delivered (as of May 31, 2009, the liquidated damages amount to RMB 7,750,332); if the aforesaid premises cannot be delivered, order Jialei Company to pay the corresponding value of the premises, and pay liquidated damages until the full amount is paid; (5) an order that Jialei Company return the rent already obtained from leasing Dongrun Company's inner shop of 848.5 square meters in Dongjia Shopping Center, totaling RMB 593,050 (calculated at the rate of RMB 140 per square meter per month as of May 31, 2009, with the final amount to be determined based on the rental standard for similar premises in the same location as appraised by a qualified real estate appraisal institution); (6) an order that Jialei Company pay Dongrun Company rent for the use of floors 6 to 9 of the independently constructed nine-story building (construction area of 1,732.92 square meters) in the amount of RMB 303,261 (calculated at the rate of RMB 50 per square meter per month as of May 31, 2009, with the final amount to be determined based on the rental standard for similar premises in the same location as appraised by a qualified real estate appraisal institution); (7) an order that Dashang Company directly pay Dongrun Company the unpaid rent for the use of Dongrun Company's inner shop of 848.5 square meters in Dongjia Shopping Center (calculated at the rate of RMB 140 per square meter per month, with the final amount to be determined based on the rental standard for similar premises in the same location as appraised by a qualified real estate appraisal institution); (8) an order that Jialei Company bear all litigation costs of this case.

Jialei Company defended, arguing: (1) Dongrun Company has no right to assert any rights under Articles 2(2) and 2(3) of the June 28 Agreement. Because pursuant to Articles 2(4) and 2(6) of the June 28 Agreement, Dongrun Company was responsible for signing a lease agreement with Wal-Mart before August 1, 2007. If it failed to perform that obligation, it would no longer enjoy all the rights stipulated in Article 2, and the premises and proceeds from premises under that article would revert to Jialei Company. Therefore, Dongrun Company's claims (4), (5), and (6) in the complaint should not be supported. (2) The "October 20" in Article 4 of the September 20 Agreement is merely a time limit for Dongrun Company to undertake to continue performing the obligation of signing with Wal-Mart, and does not represent an extension of the signing date between Dongrun Company and Wal-Mart. Because the precondition of the September 20 Agreement was that after Jialei Company had timely paid RMB 1 million of the RMB 21 million to Dongrun Company in accordance with the June 28 Agreement, Dongrun Company had failed to sign the lease agreement with Wal-Mart before August 1, 2007. Moreover, Jialei Company had already been in a position to sign with Wal-Mart before the June 28 Agreement. To prevent losses caused by Dongrun Company's failure to bring in Wal-Mart, Jialei Company, relying on Articles 66 and 67 of the Contract Law, refused to further perform the repayment obligation. Under the circumstances where Dongrun Company had already lost all rights under Article 2 of the June 28 Agreement and Jialei Company refused to continue performing the obligation to repay the RMB 20 million, Dongrun Company, to avoid further losses, approached Jialei Company, undertook to continue performing the obligation of signing with Wal-Mart, and guaranteed to complete the signing with Wal-Mart before October 20. Thereupon, the parties signed the September 20 Agreement. (3) Article 5 of the September 20 Agreement should be invalid. The reason is: Dongrun Company, to protect its own interests, has now filed a lawsuit to assert its rights against Jialei Company, which should be deemed that Dongrun Company's ultimate interests have been protected. On the same day the September 20 Agreement was signed, the parties separately signed a share transfer agreement, and Dongrun Company's shareholder status no longer exists, rendering that clause invalid. (4) Dongrun Company's request that Dashang Company directly pay the unpaid rent for the 848.5 square meter inner shop in Dongjia Shopping Center to Dongrun Company has no factual or legal basis. The reason is: Pursuant to Article 2 of the June 28 Agreement, because Dongrun Company failed to sign the lease agreement with Wal-Mart before August 1, 2007, it had lost all rights under Article 2 of the June 28 Agreement, and the premises and proceeds from premises under that article had reverted to Jialei Company, including the 848.5 square meter inner shop. Therefore, Jialei Company's leasing of its own inner shop to Dashang Company is lawful and valid. Dongrun Company's assertion of such claims after having lost its rights should not be supported. (5) Dongrun Company's actual investment is RMB 16.95 million, and the parties' stipulation in the agreement that the investment is RMB 21 million is erroneous. Jialei Company requests that the return be based on Dongrun Company's actual investment. At the same time, with respect to the loan of RMB 2,846,299 that Dongrun Company obtained from Jialei Company during the course of their cooperation, Jialei Company requests, pursuant to Article 99 of the Contract Law, that this amount be set off against the actual investment to be returned to Dongrun Company. (6) Because Dongrun Company failed to sign the lease agreement with Wal-Mart on time, causing substantial losses to Jialei Company, Jialei Company reserves the right to file a separate lawsuit against Dongrun Company.

Dashang Company stated that Dongrun Company's claims have no factual or legal basis, and that it is unaware of the facts alleged by Dongrun Company and that they are unrelated to Dashang Company.

The court of first instance found after trial that: (1) In this case, the June 28 Agreement and the September 20 Agreement executed by Dongrun Company and Jialei Company both represented the true intentions of the parties, their contents did not violate any prohibitive provisions of applicable laws and regulations, and did not harm the public interest. Therefore, both agreements are lawful and valid, and the parties should perform them as agreed. (2) The September 20 Agreement executed by Dongrun Company and Jialei Company was an adjustment and modification of certain terms of the June 28 Agreement, while fully affirming it. This is clearly evident from the name, wording, and content of the agreement. Therefore, after the execution of the September 20 Agreement, the portions of the June 28 Agreement that were not modified remained binding on both parties. Jialei Company's contention that, after the September 20 Agreement was executed, the parties were no longer obligated to perform the June 28 Agreement lacked sufficient grounds and was not supported. (3) Dongrun Company did not breach its obligations to Jialei Company with respect to bringing in Wal-Mart. Jialei Company should perform its obligation to deliver the premises in accordance with the June 28 Agreement. Within the time limit set by the September 20 Agreement, Dongrun Company brought in Wal-Mart, and on September 30, 2007, Dongrun Company, Jialei Company, and Wal-Mart jointly signed a Lease Contract. Thereafter, Wal-Mart entered the premises for decoration and construction as agreed. On December 25, 2008, Jialei Company, Dashang Company, and Wal-Mart signed a tripartite agreement, whereby Dashang Company paid RMB 5 million in compensation to Wal-Mart, and Wal-Mart withdrew from the leased premises. With respect to the issue of Wal-Mart being brought in and subsequently withdrawing, Dongrun Company neither breached the agreement nor bore any fault. (4) Jialei Company should perform its obligation to return the principal of the investment to Dongrun Company in accordance with the June 28 Agreement and the September 20 Agreement. Moreover, because Jialei Company has delayed performing this obligation, it should also pay interest on the investment. Pursuant to the June 28 Agreement and the September 20 Agreement, the investment amount to be returned by Jialei Company to Dongrun Company is RMB 21 million. After deducting the RMB 1 million already returned by Jialei Company to Dongrun Company, Jialei Company still owes Dongrun Company RMB 20 million plus interest. Jialei Company's assertion that the actual investment was RMB 16.95 million and that a loan of RMB 2,846,299 from Jialei Company to Dongrun Company in the course of their dealings should also be deducted from the overall amount to be returned was insufficiently evidenced and was not accepted. (5) In the June 28 Agreement, Jialei Company had already acknowledged that proceeds of RMB 13,144,873 from nine housing units already sold belonged to Dongrun Company, and the September 20 Agreement stipulated the time for repayment. This amount should be paid by Jialei Company to Dongrun Company. Given that the liquidated damages clause set by the parties in the June 28 Agreement for late payment of this amount was not clearly defined, Dongrun Company's claim for liquidated damages for late repayment was not supported. Instead, Jialei Company should pay interest on this amount to Dongrun Company. (6) Dongrun Company's claim seeking direct payment of rent by Dashang Company to Dongrun Company had no legal basis and was not supported. In summary, pursuant to Articles 8, 60, and 107 of the Contract Law of the People's Republic of China, the court made the following judgment: (1) Within 10 days after this judgment takes effect, Jialei Company shall return to Dongrun Company RMB 20 million plus interest (calculated from March 1, 2008, to the date of payment, at the loan interest rate of the People's Bank of China for the corresponding period). (2) Within 10 days after this judgment takes effect, Jialei Company shall pay to Dongrun Company the proceeds from the nine housing units already sold, totaling RMB 13,144,873, plus interest (calculated from April 1, 2008, to the date of payment, at the loan interest rate of the People's Bank of China for the corresponding period). (3) Within 10 days after this judgment takes effect, Jialei Company shall deliver to Dongrun Company the following premises: the inner shop at the northwest corner of the first floor of Dongjia Shopping Center with a construction area of 848.5 square meters [specifically: bounded on the north by the south side of axes I-K (excluding the area occupied by the Wal-Mart loading dock), on the south by the north edge of the Wal-Mart main passageway between axes I-E and I-F (2.4 meters south of axis I-F), on the east by the west edge of the Wal-Mart main passageway between axes I-6 and I-7 (3 meters east of axis I-6), on the west by axis I-2 (excluding the areas of stairwells, freight elevator rooms and anterooms, the fire-protection zone of the escalator, and the main passageways within the zone) — the inner shop of 1,000 square meters, less the inner shops numbered 1N-A26, 1N-A034, 1N-B062, and 1N-B61 (151.5 square meters)]; the ground-floor street-facing storefront on the south side of Dongjia Shopping Center facing Jiefang Road with a construction area of 417.84 square meters and the mezzanine floor of 417.84 square meters [specifically: the ground-floor street-facing storefront and mezzanine on the south side of the shopping center facing Jiefang Road, less the outer shops numbered 1M-06, 1M-08, 1M-07, 1M-05, 1M-06 (237.23 square meters) and the mezzanine of those outer shops (237.23 square meters)]; and the independently constructed nine-story building on the east side of Jialei Scholar Mansion, floors 1 to 9, with a construction area of 3,899.07 square meters, and shall handle the issuance of land use certificates and property ownership certificates for Dongrun Company, with the necessary fees to be paid in accordance with the provisions of the national land and property authorities. If Jialei Company is unable to perform the obligation to deliver the above premises, it shall pay the corresponding amount in cash at the market sales price for similar commercial premises in the same location as of June 28, 2007. (4) Dongrun Company's other claims are dismissed. The case acceptance fee of RMB 541,800 and the property preservation fee of RMB 5,000, totaling RMB 546,800, are to be borne by Dongrun Company in the amount of RMB 218,720 and by Jialei Company in the amount of RMB 328,080.

Jialei Company, dissatisfied with the first-instance judgment, appealed to this court, arguing that the first-instance judgment lacked legal and factual basis and seriously infringed upon the lawful rights and interests of Jialei Company. It requested: (1) to vacate the first-instance judgment, modify the judgment according to law, and dismiss all of Dongrun Company's claims; (2) to confirm the invalidity of the "Joint Development Agreement," the "June 28 Agreement," and the "September 20 Agreement"; and (3) to have Dongrun Company bear all litigation costs of this case. Facts and reasons: First, the first-instance court erred in both ordering the return of investment and interest and ordering the division of the subject matter resulting from the investment. From the perspective of the legal relationship of investment, in this case, Dongrun Company agreed to invest RMB 150 million but actually invested only RMB 16.95 million, recovering less than one-tenth of its investment, yet Dongrun Company also sought to obtain a subject matter that could only be completed with an investment of approximately RMB 100 million, which is clearly erroneous. If the first-instance judgment were enforced, Jialei Company would still need to pay RMB 13,144,873 and interest plus the ninth floor (3,899.70 square meters), the Liberation Road street-front shop (417.84 square meters), the mezzanine (417.84 square meters), and 848.50 square meters of interior shops, totaling 5,583.88 square meters multiplied by RMB 3,500 (the estimated average price per square meter as of June 28, 2007), amounting to RMB 53,688,453. Dongrun Company, without investing a single cent (with principal and interest fully protected), would receive over three times its investment from Jialei Company, which is clearly unfair. Second, the first-instance court erred in finding the June 28 and September 20 agreements valid. The June 28 and September 20 agreements were conditional (and also subject to a time limit). As of the date of the judgment, Wal-Mart had not entered the Yanbian area. Under the law, since the condition was not fulfilled, Jialei Company was not required to fulfill its promise to perform the agreements that had not yet taken effect. Given the fact that Wal-Mart did not enter, Jialei Company's expected benefits were not realized, and Dongrun Company should not receive a huge profit share. Third, Dongrun Company engaged in illegal conduct. 1. Dongrun Company concealed its withdrawal of capital contributions and false declaration of registered capital, fabricating a foreign investment background to deceive Jialei Company into cooperating with it; 2. It promised Jialei Company an investment of RMB 150 million but actually invested only RMB 16.95 million; 3. Its promise to introduce Wal-Mart to Jialei Company and relevant authorities was clearly false; 4. In the June 28 and September 20 agreements, Dongrun Company even included funds used for commercial bribery of Wal-Mart in its investment. Fourth, the first-instance court erred in ordering Jialei Company to return RMB 20 million in investment to Dongrun Company. Dongrun Company's actual investment was only RMB 16.95 million. In addition to the RMB 1 million already returned, during the course of the joint development, Dongrun Company, for the purpose of developing other projects and repaying debts, had separately withdrawn RMB 2,846,229 from Jialei Company. Therefore, under the Contract Law, this should offset the debt formed by the investment. Fifth, the first-instance court erred in ordering Jialei Company to pay RMB 13,144,873 for the nine already-sold apartments. Assuming the June 28 agreement was valid, Dongrun Company had no right to obtain the property rights or income rights to those nine apartments. The properties involved in the nine commercial apartments were all within the scope of property specified in Article 2 of the June 28 agreement. Because Dongrun Company failed to sign a lease agreement with Wal-Mart before August 1, 2007, and introduce Wal-Mart, Dongrun Company had forfeited all rights under the June 28 agreement, and the property and property income under that clause now belong to Jialei Company. Sixth, the first-instance court erred in ordering Jialei Company to deliver to Dongrun Company, after the judgment took effect, the street-front shop on the first floor of the East Jialei Shopping Center's south side on Liberation Road with a construction area of 417.84 square meters and a mezzanine area of 417.84 square meters, and to have the ownership documents handled by Dongrun Company. Assuming the June 28 agreement was valid and not conditional, Dongrun Company still failed to introduce Wal-Mart within the agreed time, i.e., before August 1, 2007, which constituted a breach of contract and also should result in the loss of the contractual right to obtain benefits. Seventh, the agreements in dispute were signed by Wang Lina and Wang Yingchao maliciously exploiting the principle of shareholders' limited liability, using a legitimate entity to conceal an illegal purpose, and by means of providing false business licenses, thereby harming national interests.

Dongrun Company argued in response: (1) The RMB 21 million and the subject property were the rights and interests Dongrun Company was entitled to receive after the termination of the "Joint Development Agreement" signed between Dongrun Company and Jialei Company, following settlement, and were agreed upon by both parties in the June 28 agreement and the September 20 agreement. Dongrun Company is entitled to obtain such assets, and the first-instance judgment correctly handled this. (2) The "Joint Development Agreement," the June 28 agreement, and the September 20 agreement reflected the true intentions of Dongrun Company and Jialei Company, and did not fall under any of the circumstances in Article 52 of the Contract Law rendering a contract void; they are lawful and valid. Jialei Company's claim that the above agreements are invalid lacks factual basis and should not be supported. (3) The June 28 agreement and the September 20 agreement clearly stipulate that Dongrun Company is entitled to receive RMB 21 million. Jialei Company's assertion that Dongrun Company invested only RMB 16.95 million and that Dongrun Company has a claim of RMB 2,846,229 which should be offset lacks factual basis and should not be supported. (4) Dongrun Company fulfilled its obligation under the June 28 agreement and the September 20 agreement to sign a lease agreement with Wal-Mart and is entitled to the subject property and the sales proceeds from the nine apartments. Jialei Company's claim that Dongrun Company is not entitled to such assets lacks factual basis and should not be supported. In summary, the first-instance judgment found the facts clearly and applied the law correctly. It requested that the appeal be dismissed and the judgment be affirmed.

Dashang Company stated that it recognized the content of subparagraph (4) of the first-instance judgment and that the lease relationship between Dashang Company and Jialei Company should be protected. If the property rights were changed to Dongrun Company's name as a result of the judgment, then under the law, Dongrun Company should also continue to perform the lease relationship with Dashang Company.

Facts found by this court in the second instance were the same as those found by the first-instance court.

Opinion of the court: The issues in dispute in this second instance are: (1) Whether the "Letter of Intent for Cooperation," the "Joint Development Agreement," the June 28 agreement, and the September 20 agreement signed by the parties are lawful and valid. (2) The relationship between the June 28 agreement and the September 20 agreement, whether Dongrun Company performed the content agreed upon in the September 20 agreement, and whether Jialei Company should perform the payment obligations agreed upon in the agreements to Dongrun Company.

Regarding issue (1): The "Letter of Intent for Cooperation," the "Joint Development Agreement," the June 28 agreement, and the September 20 agreement signed by the parties are all true expressions of the parties' intent. The content of the above agreements does not violate mandatory provisions of laws or regulations. The first-instance court correctly found that the above agreements were lawful and valid and that both parties should perform them accordingly, which is legally sound. During the first-instance trial of this case, Jialei Company did not claim that the agreements in dispute were all void, and the parties did not form a dispute on this issue. During the second instance, Jialei Company's assertion that the above agreements are void lacks factual and legal basis, and this court does not support it.

Regarding issue (2): The June 28 agreement and the September 20 agreement signed by the parties both serve as amendments and supplements to the "Joint Development Agreement." The September 20 agreement clearly states that the June 28 agreement reflects the true intentions of both parties and is a lawful and valid agreement. The parties, in order to better perform their obligations, made new arrangements in the September 28 agreement regarding issues arising during performance. Judging from the content and internal connection of the two agreements, the September 20 agreement, based on the June 28 agreement, reflects the parties' further intention to amend and reach consensus. For the parts amended or changed, the September 20 agreement governs; for the parts not amended or changed, the June 28 agreement remains binding on the parties. From the wording of the September 20 agreement, it cannot be concluded that it negates the June 28 agreement. Only when combined with the content of the two agreements is the allocation of rights and obligations between the parties complete. Because Jialei Company did not pay the investment amount to Dongrun Company in accordance with the June 28 agreement, and Dongrun Company also did not introduce Wal-Mart within the period stipulated in that agreement, on the basis that neither party performed the June 28 agreement, the parties formed the new arrangement in the September 20 agreement. The September 20 agreement both extended the deadline for Jialei Company's payment and correspondingly extended the time for Dongrun Company to introduce Wal-Mart. Regarding the introduction of Wal-Mart, Dongrun Company introduced Wal-Mart within the time stipulated in the September 20 agreement, and Dongrun Company, Jialei Company, and Wal-Mart signed a "House Lease Contract." Judging from the perspective of the balance of rights and obligations between the parties, Dongrun Company completed the contract signing with Wal-Mart on September 30, 2007, in accordance with the September 20 agreement, and Jialei Company should perform its obligation to deliver the house in accordance with the June 28 agreement. Jialei Company's claim that Dongrun Company should bear the liability for breach of contract alone, thereby relieving Jialei Company of its obligation to deliver the house to Dongrun Company, lacks sufficient reasoning. Thereafter, after Dashang Company paid RMB 5 million in compensation to Wal-Mart in accordance with the contract, Wal-Mart withdrew from the leased premises. Dongrun Company was not at fault and did not constitute a breach of contract regarding the introduction and withdrawal of Wal-Mart. Jialei Company submitted no corresponding evidence on this disputed issue during the second instance. According to the June 28 agreement, both parties recognized that the proceeds from the nine already-sold apartments, amounting to RMB 13,144,873, belonged to Dongrun Company, and the September 20 agreement stipulated the time for payment; therefore, Jialei Company should pay this amount plus interest to Dongrun Company. In the two agreements mentioned above, both parties agreed that the investment amount Jialei Company should return to Dongrun Company was RMB 21 million, and after deducting the amount already repaid, Jialei Company should return RMB 20 million plus interest to Dongrun Company. Jialei Company's assertion that Dongrun Company's actual investment was only RMB 16.95 million and that a loan of RMB 2,846,229 from Dongrun Company should be deducted lacks sufficient evidence and should not be supported. The first-instance court's findings on the above issues were clear and the application of law was correct. The first-instance judgment ordering Jialei Company to pay Dongrun Company the proceeds from the sold apartments and to deliver the remaining apartments in accordance with the agreements was not improper and should be affirmed.

In summary, the first-instance judgment found the facts clearly and applied the law correctly. Pursuant to Article 153, Paragraph 1, Item (1) of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, the judgment is as follows:

The appeal is dismissed, and the original judgment is affirmed.

The second-instance case acceptance fee of RMB 541,800 shall be borne by Jilin Jialei Real Estate Group Co., Ltd.

This judgment is final.
